finding.title: Serializer recursion, framing, and diagnostic boundaries were incomplete
finding.status: locally fixed and affected-path performance cleared
finding.impact: Attacker-controlled JSON, MessagePack, or CBOR nesting could overflow the Dart stack. MessagePack and CBOR accepted trailing encoded values, binary fast paths truncated floating-point WAMP integer fields, valid indefinite CBOR could bypass the seven-field WAMP envelope bound, and malformed JSON diagnostics could expose payload contents through FormatException text. Network frame limits constrain input size, but do not make recursive stack exhaustion or secret-bearing diagnostics safe.
prerequisites: An untrusted peer can submit a serialized WAMP frame or PPT payload to a Connectanum serializer through an admitted transport path.
For diagnostic disclosure, the surrounding application or transport records the propagated decoder exception or the serializer failure logger.
No authentication or authorization bypass was demonstrated.

deep_json.result: A 65,536-level nested result raised StackOverflowError during binary-string traversal.

security_suite.result: The initial cross-serializer resource-bound suite failed before production changes.

indefinite_cbor_arity.result: The frozen serializer accepted an eight-field Result encoded as an RFC 8949 indefinite-length array.

json_diagnostic.result: Dart's malformed JSON FormatException included the source line and exposed the probe secret.

coverage: Depth 64 remains accepted and depth 65 is rejected across JSON, MessagePack, definite CBOR, and indefinite CBOR.
PPT and non-array binary roots receive the same complete-value and depth validation.
Recognized fixed-shape and payload-bearing WAMP envelopes reject more than seven fields.
MessagePack, definite CBOR, and indefinite CBOR reject trailing encoded values.
Core binary WAMP integer fields reject floating-point values instead of truncating them.
JSON structural characters inside strings do not affect nesting enforcement.
Malformed JSON exceptions report only input length and not source contents.

deep_nesting_probe.result: MessagePack depth 8,192, CBOR depth 8,192, and JSON depth 65,536 each failed with a bounded FormatException rather than StackOverflowError.

indefinite_cbor_probe.result: The eight-field indefinite CBOR Result is rejected with FormatException.

json_diagnostic_probe.result: The propagated error is FormatException: Invalid JSON WAMP message (28 chars), without source contents.

binary_diagnostic_probe.result: Malformed CBOR and MessagePack failures do not contain the embedded probe bytes.

protocol_contract.cbor_indefinite_arrays: Supported because WAMP CBOR uses RFC 8949 and indefinite-length arrays are valid CBOR; they are scanned and bounded rather than rejected as an encoding class.
protocol_contract.binary_consumption: MessagePack and CBOR WAMP frames and PPT values must consume the complete supplied byte sequence.
protocol_contract.integer_handling: Core binary WAMP integer fragments accept integers only; floating-point values are not silently truncated.
protocol_contract.diagnostics: Serializer failure logs contain only serializer kind and input length. Malformed JSON FormatException text contains only a generic message and character count.
unchanged: Valid WAMP message wire shapes and serializer identifiers
MessagePack and CBOR lazy payload views within the enforced boundary
Transport frame limits, authentication, authorization, TLS, and package versions

methodology.gbit_definition: Encoded frame bytes multiplied by completed deserializations and eight, divided by measured loop time and 1e9; this is an in-memory parser rate, not network wire bandwidth.
methodology.investigation_rule: Investigate a candidate median below -5%, or a slower non-overlapping candidate range.
methodology.correctness_rule: Every sample must return a message for every iteration and all checksums must equal warmups plus measured iterations.
methodology.host: Apple M3 Ultra, 32 cores, 512 GB memory, macOS 26.6.2 arm64, Dart 3.13.1. No audit-owned build, test, benchmark, or local-model workload overlapped a timed process; unrelated shared-host work was not controlled.

investigation_history: The first long AOT candidate placed the seven-field check before dispatch. Its JSON control median was 5.08% lower with overlapping ranges, so it was not accepted as final evidence.

A no-redaction diagnostic and a single-read message-ID diagnostic did not recover the JSON control rate; their raw hashes are 079d775fbb0244ae6e2fb1a0d6ab6c0e0f0050f60d629428fbf1793b10dbc2d0 and 5613f5ed5536e119af2f3fdafa9b3ebe311a2025b03231b6f7e05e84e7826e1a.
Removing only the unconditional pre-dispatch arity check recovered the JSON control median to 0.311055 GBit/s. The diagnostic hash is e5a174bd02545b6c44c3423a6ec919addf7dc8fb0c400ff015726a8c8dac81aa.
The retained implementation validates fixed messages after recognized dispatch and payload messages inside their existing payload path. The final JSON control delta is -0.52% with overlapping ranges.

The earlier complete long AOT campaign showed MessagePack control, nested, and 16 KiB deltas of -0.75%, +0.78%, and +2.68%; the final campaign shows -3.79%, -0.99%, and -4.72% for unchanged MessagePack code. Both campaigns and the unfavorable final values are retained; this direction change is shared-host variability, not evidence of a stable candidate slowdown or speedup. The earlier aggregate hash is a41ae54515d7b3b2b35db4ce62b56fb2527edb886af2955561c2d6ca109d1508.
performance.interpretation: All ordinary baseline/candidate throughput ranges overlap, all checksums are valid, no median crosses the -5% investigation threshold, and median process RSS differs by 0.43%. The indefinite-CBOR path is faster because it now uses a bounded direct range scan rather than a full fallback decode. This supports no material affected-path regression on this shared host, not identical timing or a universal production throughput claim.

verification.full_verify: passed after final documentation updates; the first full run hit one HTTP/3 handshake timeout, the exact test then passed in six isolated runs, and a fresh complete bin/verify exited zero

local_companions.detail: Local Ollama and GLM loopback endpoints were denied with Operation not permitted. No sandbox bypass was attempted; source inspection, fail-first tests, static analysis, dynamic probes, and AOT comparisons provide the retained evidence.

remaining: The 64-level nesting policy is an implementation resource limit, not a new WAMP wire field or a claim that WAMP mandates that exact number.
Transport frame limits still provide the primary byte-size bound; this change does not add a separate collection-item or decoded-allocation budget.
Optional numeric detail fields and numeric option lists outside the hardened core fast-path integer fragments require separate strictness review.
Malformed short arrays can still fail through existing RangeError or type-error paths before transport-level close; error normalization remains a separate compatibility/security review.
The full component audit, prior unresolved performance comparisons, client sessions, router/MCP authorization, payload cryptography, consumer application, and packaging/platform rows remain open.
